title: Zesty British Chicken Breasts Fish And Chips
description: A light British dish featuring chicken breasts, served with a zesty twist on traditional fish and chips, complete with a cheese pull and umami flavors.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a shallow dish, mix together the flour, cornstarch, salt, pepper, and parsley.
Dip each chicken breast into the flour mixture, coating both sides evenly.
Place the coated chicken breasts on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the vegetable oil over the chicken breasts and broil for 15 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, cook the frozen french fries according to the package instructions.
In a small bowl, mix together the lemon juice and grated cheddar cheese.
Once the chicken is done, remove it from the oven and brush the lemon cheese mixture on top of each breast.
Return the chicken to the oven and broil for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Serve the chicken breasts with the cooked french fries and enjoy.
